people.name: Alfredo Federico Solf y Muro
people.nameZh: 阿爾弗雷多·索爾夫-穆羅

body.zh-Hant: 索爾夫-穆羅1872年3月15日生於秘魯蘭巴耶克（Lambayeque）。來源說他的父親是來到秘魯北部的德國移民。他在奇克拉約（Chiclayo）的聖荷西國立中學（Colegio Nacional de San José）受初等教育，之後進聖馬科斯大學，並取得博士學位。他是所謂「特別權利」的代表人物，並自1905年起在聖馬科斯任教。
body.en: Alfredo Solf y Muro was born in Lambayeque, Peru, on 15 March 1872. The source says his father was a German immigrant who had come to northern Peru. He received his elementary schooling at the Colegio Nacional de San José in Chiclayo, then attended San Marcos University, where he earned a doctorate. He was the leading exponent of the so-called special rights, and he taught at San Marcos from 1905.

citations.quote: Nació Alfredo Federico Solf y Muro en Lambayeque el 15 de marzo de 1872
el padre, un inmigrante alemán, había llegado al norte del país
cursa la instrucción elemental en Chiclayo, en el Colegio Nacional de San José
San José de Chiclayo y en la Universidad Mayor de San Marcos
Se graduó de doctor en Letras
el exponente de los llamados «derechos especiales»
Catedrático de esas disciplinas en San Marcos desde 1905

body.zh-Hant: 內閣總理府的官方史書說他曾任奇克拉約的眾議員，並在議會的外交與立法委員會任職，年份標為1911至1919年。1913年6月17日，蘇薩（Aurelio Sousa）接任內閣首長，內閣全面改組，索爾夫-穆羅以司法部門主管入閣，來源稱他是司法、宗教與教育部長。同年7月25日蘇薩辭職，兩天後新內閣由卡洛斯·帕斯·索爾丹出任司法部長。
body.en: The official history of the Presidency of the Council of Ministers says he was deputy for Chiclayo and sat on the congressional commissions on diplomacy and legislation, with the years given as 1911 to 1919. On 17 June 1913 the cabinet was rebuilt under Aurelio Sousa, and Solf y Muro joined it for the justice portfolio, which the source calls Minister of Justice, Worship and Instruction. Sousa resigned on 25 July 1913, and two days later Carlos Paz Soldán took the justice post in the new cabinet.

heading.zh-Hant: 法典編纂、財政部與校長

body.zh-Hant: 1922年，他是受命編纂新民法典的四位法學家之一，並受託準備物權篇。官方史書說他1933年率秘魯代表團出席蒙特維多的美洲國際會議，次年出任財政與商業部長，任至1935年。同年他當選聖馬科斯大學校長，任至1940年。同書另一處把他列在1933年6月底豪爾赫·普拉多內閣的財政部長，與1934年的說法不一致。
body.en: In 1922 he was one of the four jurists called together to draft the new Civil Code, and he was entrusted with preparing the book on real rights. The official history says he led the Peruvian delegation to the Inter-American conference at Montevideo in 1933, was named minister of finance and commerce the following year, and held that post until 1935. That year he was elected rector of San Marcos University, serving until 1940. Another passage in the same book lists him as finance minister in the Jorge Prado cabinet at the end of June 1933, which does not match the 1934 account.

heading.en: Premier and foreign minister, and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1939年12月8日，曼努埃爾·普拉多·烏加特切接任國家元首，索爾夫-穆羅在其首屆內閣中任內閣會議主席並兼外交部長。1942年1月29日，他以這個身分代表秘魯簽署與厄瓜多的《里約熱內盧和平、友好與邊界議定書》。1944年12月8日，內閣向總統提出辭呈。1969年8月14日，他在利馬去世。
body.en: On 8 December 1939 Manuel Prado Ugarteche took over as head of state, and in his first cabinet Solf y Muro was president of the Council of Ministers and foreign minister. On 29 January 1942, in that capacity, he represented Peru at the signing of the Rio de Janeiro Protocol of Peace, Friendship and Boundaries with Ecuador. On 8 December 1944 the cabinet submitted its resignation to the president. He died in Lima on 14 August 1969.

body.zh-Hant: 齊姆（Ernst Bruno Ziehm）1867年5月1日生於達梅勞（Damerau，波蘭文 Dąbrowa Malborska）。他在但澤讀完皇家文理中學，1887至1890年在圖賓根、其後在萊比錫與柏林攻讀法律與政治學，1892年起在萊比錫取得法學博士。
body.en: Ernst Bruno Ziehm was born on 1 May 1867 at Damerau (Polish: Dąbrowa Malborska). He finished the Royal Gymnasium in Danzig, then studied law and political science at Tübingen from 1887 to 1890 and afterwards at Leipzig and Berlin. From 1892 he held a doctorate in law from Leipzig.

citations.quote: ERNST BRUNO ZIEHM (1 V 1867 w Dąbrowie Malborskiej (Damerau)
Ukończył w Gdańsku Gimnazjum Królewskie na Dolnym Mieście.
W Tybindze (Tübingen, 1887–1890), Lipsku (1890–1891) i Berlinie
studiował prawo i nauki polityczne
Od 1892 doktor prawa w Lipsku

body.zh-Hant: 齊姆1898年起在西普魯士省行政機關擔任輔助人員。1905至1914年他在奧波萊（Opole）任政府顧問，1914年出任但澤行政法庭庭長，1919年轉任但澤高等行政法庭，並於1922至1930年擔任但澤最高行政法院院長。
body.en: From 1898 Ziehm worked as an auxiliary official in the provincial administration of West Prussia. From 1905 to 1914 he was a government councillor at Opole. In 1914 he became director of the administrative tribunal in Danzig, in 1919 of Danzig's Higher Administrative Tribunal, and from 1922 to 1930 he was president of the Danzig Supreme Administrative Court.

citations.quote: Od 1898 był pracownikiem pomocniczym w administracji prowincji Prusy Zachodnie
W latach 1905–1914 był radcą rządowym w Opolu
w 1914 został dyrektorem trybunału administracyjnego w Gdańsku
w 1919 gdańskiego Wyższego Trybunału Administracyjnego
Od 1922 do 1930 był prezesem Najwyższego Sądu Administracyjnego w Gdańsku

body.zh-Hant: 1920年，齊姆以但澤制憲會議成員身分參與但澤自由市憲法的制定，並自第一屆至第五屆（1920至1935年）擔任議會（Volkstag）議員。他屬德意志民族人民黨（DNVP），並在1920年12月6日至1924年12月10日任但澤參議院副議長。1930年大選後，他與中央黨領袖薩瓦茨基（Anton Sawatzki）組成聯盟，並在納粹黨的政治支持下，於1931年1月9日當選參議院議長。
body.en: In 1920 Ziehm took part, as a member of the constituent assembly, in drafting the constitution of the Free City of Danzig, and he sat in the Volkstag from the first to the fifth term (1920 to 1935). He belonged to the German National People's Party (DNVP) and was vice-president of the Danzig Senate from 6 December 1920 to 10 December 1924. After the 1930 elections he formed a coalition with Centre Party leader Anton Sawatzki and, with the political backing of the NSDAP, was elected president of the Senate on 9 January 1931.

Zasiadał w Volkstagu II WMG od I do V kadencji (1920–1935)
Należał do nacjonalistyczno-konserwatywnej Niemiecko Narodowej Partii Ludowej
Od 6 XII 1920 do 10 XII 1924 był wiceprezydentem Senatu II WMG
Po wyborach w 1930 do Volkstagu IV kadencji
przywódcy Partii Centrum (Zentrumspartei) Antona Sawatzkiego
utworzył z nim koalicję
na które został wybrany 9 I 1931
także dzięki politycznemu poparciu NSDAP

heading.en: President of the Senate: record in office

body.zh-Hant: 齊姆任內遇上經濟大蕭條與失業急升，同時波蘭與但澤的關係日益緊張，來源列出1933年2月15日港口警察遭解散、格丁尼亞問題，以及3月6日波蘭軍艦「維利亞號」駛入韋斯特布拉特等事件。1933年3月，他因韋斯特布拉特事件兩度與希特勒（Adolf Hitler）會談。
body.en: His term coincided with the Great Depression and a sharp rise in unemployment, and tension between Poland and Danzig grew. The source lists the dissolution of the port police on 15 February 1933, the Gdynia question, and the entry of the Polish warship Wilia into Westerplatte on 6 March 1933. In March 1933 he spoke twice with Adolf Hitler about the Westerplatte affair.

citations.quote: wielki kryzys gospodarczy i gwałtowny wzrost
wzrostu napięcia w stosunkach polsko-gdańskich
rozwiązanie 15 II 1933 policji portowej
kwestia Gdyni
6 III 1933 wpłynięcie ORP „Wilia” na Westerplatte
dwukrotnie w marcu rozmawiał z Adolfem Hitlerem

heading.en: Leaving office and withdrawal from politics

body.zh-Hant: 1933年2月7日，但澤納粹黨領袖福爾斯特（Albert Forster）與其副手格賴澤爾（Arthur Greiser）向他發出最後通牒，要求解散議會並把參議院議長職位交給納粹黨人。兩篇Gedanopedia條目對他卸任日的記載不同：他個人條目寫他在1933年5月30日停止擔任議長，參議院條目則把他的任期列為1931年1月9日至1933年6月20日。他在1935年之後退出政治活動。
body.en: On 7 February 1933 the Danzig Nazi leader Albert Forster and his deputy Arthur Greiser sent him an ultimatum demanding the dissolution of the Volkstag and the handing of the Senate presidency to a Nazi. The two Gedanopedia entries differ on when he left office: his own entry says he ceased to be president on 30 May 1933, while the Senate entry lists his term as 9 January 1931 to 20 June 1933. After 1935 he withdrew from political activity.

body.zh-Hant: 哈定1865年11月2日生於俄亥俄州的布盧明格羅夫（Blooming Grove）。米勒中心說他的雙親都是醫生。1884年他與兩位朋友湊了300美元，買下幾乎倒閉的《馬里昂星報》（Marion Star）。1891年，他與一位當地離過婚的女子結婚，即弗洛倫斯·克林·德沃爾夫（Florence Kling De Wolfe）。
body.en: Warren G. Harding was born on 2 November 1865 in Blooming Grove, Ohio. The Miller Center says both his parents were doctors. In 1884 he raised 300 dollars with two friends to buy the nearly defunct Marion Star newspaper. In 1891 he married a local divorcee, Florence Kling De Wolfe.

heading.zh-Hant: 俄亥俄州政壇與參議員選舉
heading.en: Ohio politics and the Senate race

body.zh-Hant: 國會圖書館記載，哈定在1899至1903年任俄亥俄州參議員，1904至1905年任俄亥俄州副州長。米勒中心說他連任兩屆州參議員並當過多數黨領袖，1910年競選州長失敗。1912年他在黨代表大會上提名塔夫脫（Taft）。1914年他贏得共和黨聯邦參議員初選，並在大選中擊敗司法部長蒂莫西·霍根（Timothy Hogan）。
body.en: The Library of Congress records that Harding served in the Ohio Senate from 1899 to 1903 and as lieutenant governor of Ohio in 1904 and 1905. The Miller Center says he won two terms in the state senate, serving as majority leader, and lost a bid for governor in 1910. In 1912 he placed Taft's name in nomination at the party convention. In 1914 he won the Republican primary for the U.S. Senate and beat Attorney General Timothy Hogan in the general election.

body.zh-Hant: 國會圖書館記載他在1915至1921年任聯邦參議員。米勒中心說他在參議院缺席的會期比出席的多，卻在1916年共和黨全國大會擔任基調演講人與大會主席。在國際聯盟問題上，他與參議員洛奇（Henry Cabot Lodge）站在一起，反對威爾遜版本的國聯。白宮歷史頁面說，1920年共和黨大會僵持不下，一群參議員轉向他，他並在總統大選中以約六成選票獲勝。
body.en: The Library of Congress records him as a U.S. Senator from 1915 to 1921. The Miller Center says he missed more sessions than he attended in the Senate, yet served as keynote speaker and chairman of the 1916 Republican national convention. On the League of Nations he stood with Senator Henry Cabot Lodge against Woodrow Wilson's version. The White House history page says that when the 1920 Republican convention deadlocked, a group of senators turned to him, and he won the presidential election with about 60 percent of the vote.

body.zh-Hant: 白宮歷史頁面說，共和黨國會議員輕易取得總統簽署其法案：他們取消了戰時管制、大幅減稅、建立聯邦預算制度、恢復高保護關稅，並嚴格限制移民。後來他聽說有友人利用官位謀私。1923年8月他在舊金山因心臟病去世；國會圖書館記他於1923年8月2日在任內去世。
body.en: The White House history page says Republicans in Congress easily got the president's signature on their bills: they eliminated wartime controls, slashed taxes, established a federal budget system, restored the high protective tariff and tightly limited immigration. Word later reached him that some of his friends were using their official positions for their own enrichment. He died of a heart attack in San Francisco in August 1923, and the Library of Congress records that he died in office on August 2, 1923.
